# GrowitBuddy

> GrowitBuddy builds positioning, production, distribution, and inbound demand systems for founders and creators. We help brands and creators grow with content, an owned distribution network, and a vetted influencer/creator network that delivers measurable results.

GrowitBuddy is a growth and content agency. Founded by Suraj Sharma (Founder & CEO). Contact: hello@growitbuddy.com. Website: https://growitbuddy.com

## What GrowitBuddy does

- **Positioning & strategy**: clarify a brand's message and market position.
- **Content production**: end-to-end content creation for founders and creators.
- **Distribution network**: an owned network of pages and creators that reaches millions, used to amplify content.
- **Influencer / creator network**: a vetted network of creators brands can work with.
- **Inbound demand systems**: systems that turn content and distribution into qualified inbound leads.

## Who it is for

Founders, startups, and creators who want to grow their audience and inbound demand through high-quality content and reliable distribution.
